_doc: Re-check of every LIVE publicationStatus=approved toyota entry in platform/catalogue/catalogue.v2.json against the 2026-08-09 glazing ruling and the flat-shell / global-alpha-shell signatures. Both marques shipped BEFORE those rulings and before glass_probe existed. Probed with pipeline/ingest/glass_probe.py probe(url=...) against the SHIPPED desktopGlbUrl -- the shipped asset, not the wave sheet, per the CLAUDE.md evidence rule that cost 39 wrongful quarantines. NOTHING HERE HAS BEEN QUARANTINED: these are candidates with evidence, for the owner to confirm by render.
_probe_validation: glass_probe scored 106/107 against pipeline/ingest/PORSCHE_GLASS.json ground truth at the time of this run; the single miss is certainty=inferred, which is routed to the eye and never failed.

rows.recommendation: no defect found -- FALSE POSITIVE, checked by hand and cleared. The only transparent non-glazing material is 'black_uniform' at alpha 0.0, a single hidden helper. GR86_Paint is OPAQUE red, Shared_Tire_Race02_N is OPAQUE black with a texture, and the glazing (Glass_Parts 0.315, Tinted_glass 0.529) is properly transparent. This is NOT a global-alpha shell.

_alpha_shell_note: ZERO genuine global-alpha shells among live Toyota or Peugeot. Five were raised on the first pass and ALL FIVE were false positives: glass_probe's BODYISH pattern matches the word 'black', and PRIVACY GLASS is routinely named black_glass / glass_black / Camry07-windows-black / e-2008_glass_black -- materials that are SUPPOSED to be transparent. glass_probe was fixed in this session to exclude GLASSY names from the body/rubber test (re-validated 106/107 on PORSCHE_GLASS.json, no regression). The genuine signature is 'carpaint' AND 'tire' both at alpha 0.25, which no live entry carries.
